images.name: 상현 거월·장미월
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A brand-new legendary high-fantasy MMORPG weapon concept for Twilight of the Blue Moon. ONE SINGLE COMPLETE BOW ONLY on a portrait 1024x1536 image (2:3). Upright, near-front with just a slight three-quarter angle, weapon fills about 86% of the canvas height. Leave at least 5% completely empty margin on all four sides; ALL upper and lower tips fully visible. Clean flat almost-black midnight background. No text, captions, labels, watermark, borders, grid, inset or alternate views, second bow, arrows, hands, characters, swords or staffs.
The crucial requirement is bold STRUCTURAL UPPER-LOWER ASYMMETRY clearly visible from the silhouette at thumbnail size: upper and lower limbs must have DIFFERENT lengths, widths, mass distribution, shapes and ornament rhythm. Do not mirror the upper limb onto the lower limb and do not solve asymmetry with tiny accessories. Keep a legible functional central handgrip, open space behind the grip, coherent recurve limb construction and ONE taut fine bowstring directly connecting the limb tips. Elegant flowing fantastical construction, strong beautiful silhouette, not a random pile of blades.
Noble radiant blue is the primary material: rich cobalt moonstone, translucent azure crystal and pearl-blue lunar glass, with a visibly recognizable BLUE MOON built into the physical design. Metal only as sparse fine joining lines. No predominant grey steel, no blue-painted ordinary metal. Crisp exquisite surface detail and strong material depth, restrained luminosity, no huge halo, no fog, no floating debris. Asymmetric concept: MASSIVE BROAD CRESCENT UPPER LIMB versus a VERY LONG THIN LOWER LIMB. The upper section is one large sculpted cobalt crescent, its open bite visible, about twice the width of anything below the grip; its upper hooked tip curls inward. Place the grip somewhat above the bow's overall vertical midpoint. The lower limb extends much farther down as a spare elegant tapering blue-moonlight reed with one gentle S-bend and a tiny recurved endpoint. The lower half must NOT have a second matching crescent, fan, wing or bulky ornament. Contrasting compact heavy crescent above and stretched graceful fine line below is the defining silhouette.

visual_qa.note: 상단의 넓고 묵직한 초승달과 하단의 아주 길고 가는 곡선이 대조된다. 중앙보다 높은 그립과 연결된 단일 시위, 양 끝 모두 확인.
